Rolled back to v2.3.0 (the most recent healthy production release) in all regions. args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what was completed:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: checkout-api was on v2.3.1 across all three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), failing health checks with an 18% error rate. The deployment history showed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release — v2.3.0 was the most recent healthy one.

2. **Rolled back to v2.3.0 in all regions**: Rollout completed successfully, and I verified the service is now healthy with the error rate back down to ~0.2%.

3. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001, on-call paged) documenting the failed v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback to v2.3.0, and the post-rollback verification.

Note: v2.3.1 will need investigation before any redeploy attempt.
